doors.why: Gravewell's big dome with the cyan cross and double doors (top right) is the Recovery Bay
Striped-awning shop front west of the plaza statue with the red mat

Kade's Lab ('the ruined lab', quest area umbra_town): put on Gravewell's small orb-topped house SE of the statue; no ruined building is drawn anywhere, Lantern Streets domes (127 [6,12], 128 [5,3]/[20,11]) are the alternatives

t: Kade's Notes: 'Thorne knew. The engine does not open a door. It rings a bell, and something below is listening.'
A cracked Rift-engine prototype. The orb inside still turns, slowly, toward the floor.
The Gravewell Lantern: lit the night the city tipped into the sinkhole. It has never gone out.
A void crystal hums on the altar. Your shadow leans toward it.
Scavenger: Gravewell was a city once, before it tipped into the sinkhole.
Now we just call it home and keep the lanterns full.
Lantern keeper: Keep to the lanterns. The dark plays tricks.
If a light goes out behind you, don't turn around. Just walk faster.
Drifter: Void-types only come out where the light can't reach.
The Sinkhole is full of them. Bring something that hits hard.
Old woman: The Recovery Bay is the brightest room in town. We go there to feel warm, not just to heal.
Researcher: The black-hole sky pulls on everything here. Even sound falls a little slower.
Helix contractor: Nothing to see here. Just... measuring the sinkhole. For safety.
Move along, Linker.
Kid: My big brother says the well whispers your name if you stand at the edge long enough!
Nurse: Welcome to the Gravewell Recovery Bay. We'll have your Alienmon glowing again.
Diver: I came up from Sinkhole B3 with every team member fainted. Heal before every level down.
Clerk: Lantern oil, Stasis Pods, potions. Everything you need to go down and come back up.
Shopper: Stock up on Stasis Pods. Void-types are slippery and slip out of a weak throw.
Lab assistant: The professor left in a hurry years ago. The papers are still exactly where he dropped them.
Lantern keeper: Every lantern on this street is tended by hand. Miss one night and the shadows creep in.
Scavenger: Trainers on these streets watch from the dark. Walk into their line of sight and they'll call you out.
Pilgrim: The Sinkhole is just east. They say a Signal Shard sleeps at the very bottom.
Drifter: Past the Sinkhole stands Gravewell Tower. The Keeper there fights with the dark itself.
Traveller: You made it through the Shadow Tunnel? Most folk turn back halfway. Gravewell's just north.
Miner: B1's the easy floor. Mind the waterfalls; that glow isn't water.
Explorer: I've mapped this level three times. The tunnels never quite match my notes.
Researcher: Ghost and Void readings double every floor down. Whatever is below, it is awake.
Pilgrim: The well that whispers... listen. Do you hear it too?
Go around the rift. Never across.
Tower guard: Keeper Kade waits upstairs. Beat his apprentices first; he only sees challengers who've earned it.

notes: Umbra (11). Kade's Lab door is a judgement call (todo): Gravewell's SE orb house. Sinkhole floors are narrow cave corridors; B4 (132) routes around the central rift via the left bridge pocket and the right rope bridge. Purple foliage patches on Lantern Streets are tall grass.
